designationHistory.indexText: Brazoria National Wildlife Refuge was established to provide wintering habitat for migratory waterfowl on the upper Texas coast.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Brazoria National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Inventory and Monitoring Plan Texas Mid-Coast Wildlife Refuge Complex: Brazoria, San Bernard, and Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuges (ServCat 120434): "Brazoria NWR ... was established initially in 1966 primarily to protect wetland and migratory bird habitats"

review.note: 1966 (Texas Mid-Coast complex I&M plan). Authority assumed MBCA; exact date not found.
